about: Every researched outcome-web link, wired or waiting on the named measures some engine must provide. Generated by scripts/outcome-web/write-coverage.ts; src/core2/outcome-web.test.ts fails if this list and the code disagree.

pretrial-detention-to-conviction.carriedBy: the court's decision of each counted case (resolveDue in src/core2/public-safety.ts, run each month by runSafetyMonth), which convicts the case's defendants at the offense's base share times one plus this row's size for the share held until the case is decided, against the share money bail would have held; the sentence row (src/core2/modules/justice.ts decideCountedCase) keeps the base share, the held and money-bail shares and the size as its reasons. A named bribery defendant's verdict (hearing and convict in src/core2/modules/justice.ts) does not read it: the verdict is a margin of evidence against the defense, with no rate this proportion can scale (stopgap SG-WEB-crime-justice-links-unread)

pretrial-detention-to-employment.carriedBy: the jobs engine's pull to work (detentionShift in src/core2/jobs-web.ts, added to participationShift, which src/core2/modules/jobs.ts reads when a jobless adult chooses whether to look for work and when a worker chooses to stay, look around or leave), which reads the justice engine's own pretrial record of the person (firstHeldPretrial in src/core2/modules/justice.ts: the decision held that decidePretrial in src/core2/justice-pretrial.ts wrote) and, once this row's lag has run from the day they were first held, adds the log of one plus this row's size (carriedLink) to their choice score. The web does not run the link because its cause is a record of the individual defendant, not a rate of the place (stopgap SG-LABOR-pretrial-employment)

coverage-to-mortality-55-64.carriedBy: the health engine's monthly look at each full person (refreshWebFactors in src/core2/modules/health.ts, through ownCoverageFactor in src/core2/health-own.ts), which reads the Medicaid coverage the law reach pays them (medicaidCoverageSpells in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-money.ts, one obligation record per payment) and multiplies their death hazard at 55 to 64 by this row's size per covered year, twelve months after the coverage, against the coverage they held at their first look; the place-level medicaid-expansion-to-mortality row is left out of their web factor (deathWebFactor in src/core2/health-web.ts). Counted people keep the place-level row (stopgap SG-HEALTH-own-records-counted)

job-loss-to-death-risk.carriedBy: the health engine's monthly look at each full person (refreshWebFactors in src/core2/modules/health.ts, through displacementFactor in src/core2/health-own.ts), which reads the jobs engine's closure or layoff record on the person (displacementsNow in src/core2/job-displacement.ts: the changes table in src/core2/modules/jobs.ts, with the tenure of the job that ended) and multiplies their death hazard by one plus the paper's excess for the years since, scaled by tenure up to six years (src/core2/data/health/displacement.json). Counted people are not read (stopgap SG-HEALTH-own-records-counted)

long-hours-to-heart-and-stroke.carriedBy: the health engine's monthly look at each full person (refreshWebFactors in src/core2/modules/health.ts, through longHoursFactor in src/core2/health-own.ts), which reads the weekly hours recorded on the job they hold (hoursDaily times daysPerWeek on the job in the core's jobs) and multiplies their death hazard by one plus the heart disease and stroke shares of deaths at their age times each cause's relative risk less one at those hours (src/core2/data/health/long-hours.json), for as long as they hold it. Counted people are not read (stopgap SG-HEALTH-own-records-counted)

snap-to-food-insecurity.carriedBy: the SNAP benefit (runFoodAid in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-food-aid.ts), which owes each qualifying household, named and counted, its allotment and stops a head a law takes off it (the work requirement for assistance after the head's months, by the law row in force), and the household's monthly purchases (settle in src/core2/cost-of-living.ts), which buy its everyday plan from what its members hold, so a household that loses its benefit buys less of its plan and what it cannot buy goes unbought, kept on its month (household-month unpaidMinor, src/core2/modules/credit.ts). The research measures food insecurity, a scale the game does not keep, so the household's own unbought spending stands for it (stopgap SG-WEB-food-insecurity-ledger)

minimum-wage-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts wageFloor raises pay; src/core2/world-poverty.ts counts it

unemployment-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts: a lost job ends its pay; src/core2/world-poverty.ts counts the household

child-coverage-to-graduation.carriedBy: the web's uninsured-to-graduation link (the same Cohodes, Grossman, Kleiner and Lovenheim 2016 effect, read from the place's uninsured share five years earlier), which the school engine reads when it decides each senior's graduation (decideSchoolOutcome in src/core2/school-outcomes.ts reads webReach for school.graduation-pct, by income fifth)

prek-to-graduation.carriedBy: the web's universal-prek-to-graduation link (the same Gray-Lobe, Pathak and Walters 2023 Boston and Tennessee estimates, read from the universal-preschool law in force with a 14-year lag and a range from Tennessee's loss to Boston's gain), which the school engine reads when it decides each senior's graduation (decideSchoolOutcome in src/core2/school-outcomes.ts reads webReach for school.graduation-pct, by income fifth)

family-income-to-scores.carriedBy: for math, the web's poverty-to-math-proficiency link (the same Dahl and Lochner 2012 income effect, read as the place's poverty share into the share of eighth graders proficient in math), which the school engine reads when it decides each eighth grader's math result (decideSchoolOutcome in src/core2/school-outcomes.ts reads webReach for school.math-proficient-pct, by income fifth); the engine's income-fifth gradient (gradientOf) then spreads the place's result over the fifths. Reading is not carried: no link moves reading proficiency by family income

school-move-to-scores.carriedBy: the school engine's math test (decideSchoolOutcome in src/core2/school-outcomes.ts), which reads the counted-moves record of each household that moved into the town after the school year began (countedMoves in src/core2/modules/counted-moves.ts, direction in) and lowers each such eighth grader's own expected share of clearing the proficiency line by this row's size (carriedLink), so the fifth's expected passes fall by the size times the switchers' weight; the group row records the switchers and the result row of a full student records the move it stands on. The web does not run the link because its cause is a record of the individual student, not a rate of the place (stopgap SG-SCHOOL-switch-window)

new-apartments-to-nearby-rent.carriedBy: the housing engine's lease renewal (renewRentalLeases in src/core2/housing-occupancy.ts), which moves each renewing lease by the place's change in rental vacancy raised to the rental elasticity, so the units a new building adds lower the rents tenants renew at; the research measures one building within about 250 meters, a scale the game does not keep, so the engine's own vacancy response stands for it

eviction-to-homelessness.carriedBy: the housing engine's removal (placeRemovedHousehold in src/core2/housing-homeless.ts, called from src/core2/modules/housing.ts on each eviction judgment), which puts every evicted household with a relative who has room, in a shelter bed in the place, or on the street, named and counted households alike; the research measures one tenant's shelter use after an order, so the engine's own placement stands for it

same-day-registration-to-youth-turnout.carriedBy: the law reach's same-day registration relief (electionLawTurnoutCost in src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts), which the voting engine takes off each voter's turnout cost, fully at 18 and less with each year of age (sameDayRegistrationRelief, sameDayRegistrationAgeSpanYears), so the voter's own turnout decision carries the law; the reach's relief is the law's one size, checked against this row

all-mail-voting-to-turnout.carriedBy: the law reach's all-mail relief (electionLawTurnoutCost in src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts), which the voting engine takes off the work-time part of each voter's turnout cost (mailVotingWorkRelief), so the voter's own turnout decision carries the law; the reach's relief is the law's one size, checked against this row

exposed-corruption-to-reelection.carriedBy: the voting engine's scandal term (scandalTerm and scandalAppeal in src/core2/modules/voting.ts), which reads a candidate's bribes reported to the press and convictions the court made public (scandalStoriesOf) and lowers the candidate's appeal with each voter the story reached, weighed by how far they trust the press; counted voters take it at the share of the town's named adults it reached. It uses its own size, the 5 points of the two-party vote a tainted U.S. incumbent loses (scandalShare in src/core2/data/electorate/parameters.json), not this row's 17% fall in a Brazilian mayor's chance of reelection

economy-to-approval.carriedBy: the electorate's economy term (candidateReasons in src/core2/electorate-inputs.ts, reading nationalEconomyChange), which takes the national unemployment and inflation against the opening into the standing of the president's party's candidates, wholly for federal offices and in part down the ballot. The game keeps no approval number, so the economy's effect lands on the vote; this row has no size, so the engine's own shares (unemploymentShare and inflationShare in src/core2/data/electorate/parameters.json) stand

snap-work-requirement-to-participation.carriedBy: the SNAP benefit (runFoodAid in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-food-aid.ts), which reads the work-requirement law in force through assistanceTimeLimit (src/core2/law-reach/group-b.ts) and stops each head the law reaches after their own three months of benefit in 36 (timeLimitedNow in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-money.ts), named and counted households alike

end-cash-bail-to-pretrial-detention.carriedBy: the justice engine's pretrial decision (decidePretrial in src/core2/justice-pretrial.ts, called from src/core2/modules/justice.ts), which reads the end-cash-bail law in force and the defendant's cash when each charged defendant waits for trial: where the law has ended cash bail nobody is held for want of money (released-no-bail-law), elsewhere they are held or post bail

automatic-registration-to-turnout.carriedBy: the law reach's automatic registration relief (electionLawTurnoutCost in src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts), which the voting engine takes off each voter's turnout cost (automaticRegistrationRelief), so the voter's own turnout decision carries the law; the reach's relief is the law's one size, checked against this row

restore-voting-to-turnout.carriedBy: the law reach's eligibility (barredFromVoting and felonyDisenfranchisedShare in src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts), which takes the people a restoration law returns off the barred list, so they join the eligible voters and each decides turnout from their own record; the eligible turnout rate moves with them. The barred share is the state's (stopgap SG-GOV-REACH-A-convictions)

housing-line-to-evictions.carriedBy: src/core2/housing-assistance.ts pays the line's rent assistance into the helped household's cash; src/core2/modules/housing.ts files an eviction case only for rent owed

federal-minimum-wage-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/law-reach/group-a-wages.ts writes the wage row that src/core2/modules/jobs.ts wageFloor applies

graduation-to-poverty.carriedBy: none yet: no engine path (stopgap SG-WEB-poverty-graduation-no-engine); the measure reads the pay once the jobs engine prices schooling

crime-level-to-robbery.carriedBy: the victimization records themselves: the index this link reads (crime months.violentIndex, src/core2/modules/crime.ts) is robbery and assault per person 12 and older, so every move in it is already these offenses' own; scaling them by it again would count each move twice and feed the next month's index one for one, a loop that grows without end

crime-level-to-assault.carriedBy: the victimization records themselves: the index this link reads (crime months.violentIndex, src/core2/modules/crime.ts) is robbery and assault per person 12 and older, so every move in it is already these offenses' own; scaling them by it again would count each move twice and feed the next month's index one for one, a loop that grows without end

grocery-exemption-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: the measure counts income before taxes

licensing-reform-to-poverty.carriedBy: none yet: no engine path (stopgap SG-WEB-poverty-licensing-no-engine); the measure reads the pay once the jobs engine opens licensed jobs

income-tax-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: the measure counts income before taxes

graduated-income-tax-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: the measure counts income before taxes

anti-discrimination-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: about zero in the research; whatever incomes do shows in the measure

incentive-cap-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: about zero in the research; hiring changes reach it through pay

retirement-age-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/retirement-claims.ts reads the claim ages in the law row (src/core2/social-security-law.ts)

top-income-tax-rate-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: the measure counts income before taxes

student-loan-forgiveness-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: debt relief is not money income

grocery-exemption-to-food-insecurity.carriedBy: the sales tax engine, which spares the grocery share of each retail seller's sales where the exemption holds (syncSalesTax in src/core2/modules/budgets.ts), the business price review, which passes the tax change into the seller's tax-inclusive price (salesTaxPassThrough in src/core2/finance-state.ts), and the household's monthly purchases (settle in src/core2/cost-of-living.ts), which buy its everyday plan at those prices from what its members hold, so the exemption buys more of a short household's food and what it still cannot buy goes unbought, kept on its month (household-month unpaidMinor, src/core2/modules/credit.ts). The research measures food insecurity, a scale the game does not keep, so the household's own unbought spending stands for it (stopgap SG-WEB-food-insecurity-ledger)

city-anti-discrimination-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: about zero in the research; whatever incomes do shows in the measure

farmland-easements-to-farmland-lost.carriedBy: the builders' monthly starts decision (buildMonth in src/core2/housing-construction.ts), which reads this law in force and takes this row's size out of the share of new building that goes on farmland (the American Farmland Trust's 62%), so the land open to build on falls by that much and the town's single-family starts fall through the land-starts elasticity; each builder whose start the law restricted is recorded as the law applied (land-restricted). It applies from the law's effective date rather than after this row's five-year lag, and no record keeps the acres converted (stopgap SG-GOV-REACH-B-land-use)

groundwater-limits-to-irrigation-pumping.carriedBy: the business engine's farm groundwater limit (readGroundwaterLaw in src/core2/modules/business.ts), which reads this law in force and cuts each town farm's groundwater input by this row's size (1 + size of what the farm would pump), so the farm's outside sales fall by the irrigation-output elasticity and each month's loss is recorded as the law applied (groundwater-output-limited). It applies from the law's effective date rather than after this row's one-year lag (stopgap SG-GOV-REACH-B-business-cost)

income-tax-rate-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts: the measure counts income before taxes

unemployment-insurance-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/jobs-benefits.ts payClaims pays each open claim's benefit; src/core2/world-poverty.ts counts that benefit (weekly amount times the weeks left, at most 52) in the household's income, named and counted

unemployment-weekly-maximum-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/jobs-benefits.ts payClaims pays each open claim's benefit; src/core2/world-poverty.ts counts that benefit (weekly amount times the weeks left, at most 52) in the household's income, named and counted

revolving-door-ban-to-ex-legislator-lobb.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/interest-groups.ts passes over a former officeholder the ban still bars (lobbyingBarredUntil, src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts) when it chooses a group's lobbyist

revolving-door-ban-to-candidate-entry.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/candidacy.ts weighs the law when a would-be newcomer, named or counted, decides whether to run for a legislative seat (afterOffice, read through revolvingDoorFor in src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts; candidacyRevolvingDoorWeight is calibrated to the paper's 18.2% fewer entrants)

public-jobs-to-private-employment.carriedBy: src/core2/modules/jobs.ts fills the openings the line funds (postFundedOpenings, posted by src/core2/law-reach/group-a-staffing.ts) from named and counted seekers, and the unemployment measure counts each hire

home-rule-to-local-spending.carriedBy: src/core2/policy-authority.ts lets a town or county body legislate on what the state leaves to home rule, read by src/core2/modules/legislature.ts when a bill is drafted; the bills it passes set the ordinances and spending

public-pay-floor-to-other-employers-wage.carriedBy: src/core2/public-pay-floor.ts holdPublicPay re-rates every public job under the floor, named and counted (rerateJob), and src/core2/modules/jobs.ts payFor posts public openings at it; the wages measure reads that pay

snap-maximum-to-food-insecurity.carriedBy: the SNAP benefit (runFoodAid in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-food-aid.ts), which owes each qualifying household, named and counted, its allotment at the maximum in force, and the household's monthly purchases (settle in src/core2/cost-of-living.ts), which buy its everyday plan from what its members hold, so a larger maximum buys more of a short household's food and what it still cannot buy goes unbought, kept on its month (household-month unpaidMinor, src/core2/modules/credit.ts). The research measures food insecurity, a scale the game does not keep, so the household's own unbought spending stands for it (stopgap SG-WEB-food-insecurity-ledger)

welfare-spending-to-poverty.carriedBy: src/core2/world-poverty.ts adds the cash assistance each household draws from the welfare line (assistanceIncomeByHousehold, written by payBenefits in src/core2/law-reach/group-b-money.ts) to its yearly income before it is set against its threshold; the poverty share the web reads is that record
